title: Gazebo Apply Command
text: Send command to Gazebo simulator, 1 input, {Command type} sets Type of command; {Sample time} sets the sampling time of input. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Command type
params.values: Type of command ApplyLinkWrench (default) | ApplyJointTorque | SetLinkWorldPose | SetLinkLinearVelocity | SetLinkAngularVelocity | SetJointPosition | SetJointVelocity
